summary: Frontend-only testing of guided practice scroll fix. CRITICAL BUG FOUND: Touch scrolling still not working on mobile. The scroll structure has competing scroll contexts - outer overlay and inner container both have overflow-y-auto, but body has touch-action:none blocking touch events.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: Touch scrolling not working on mobile (390x844 and 375x812). Play button is at y=5367px but viewport is only 844px. User cannot scroll to reach play button via touch gestures.

Competing scroll contexts: Outer overlay has overflow-y-auto but doesn't scroll (scrollHeight=clientHeight=844). Inner container has scrollable content (scrollHeight=5354, clientHeight=683) but touch events blocked by body touch-action:none

issues: Intermittent babel-metadata-plugin errors in AddToJournal.jsx - transient webpack issue that resolves after cache clear

action_items: FIX SCROLL BUG: Remove overflow-y-auto from outer overlay (line 64) - it should NOT be a scroll container
Keep overflow-y-auto only on inner container (line 92) - this should be the sole scroll context
Consider removing body touch-action:none (line 50) or ensure inner container has touch-action:pan-y that overrides it
Alternative fix: Make outer overlay the scroll container by removing flex-1 min-h-0 from inner container and letting content flow naturally
critical_code_review_comments: Line 50: body.style.touchAction = 'none' blocks ALL touch events including scroll on child elements
Line 64: Outer overlay has overflow-y-auto but its content doesn't overflow (flex layout constrains it)
Line 92: Inner container has overflow-y-auto and IS scrollable (5354px content vs 683px viewport) but touch events blocked
Line 119: motion.div with flex-1 min-h-0 creates the actual scrollable content area
MINIMUM_NARRATION_MINUTES correctly set to 10 (line 29 in guidedNarrationUtils.js)
Duration labels resolve correctly via resolveDurationMinutes utility
context_for_next_testing_agent: Scroll bug NOT fixed. Programmatic scrolling works on inner container but touch gestures do not. Root cause: body touch-action:none blocks touch events. Fix requires either removing body touch-action:none or restructuring scroll containers.

guided_overlay_scrolls_on_mobile.details: Touch scroll gestures do not work. Programmatic scroll works on inner container but touch events blocked by body touch-action:none. Play button at y=5367px is unreachable via touch scroll.

no_scroll_lock_conflict.details: Scroll lock conflict exists: body has touch-action:none, outer overlay has overflow-y-auto (but doesn't scroll), inner container has overflow-y-auto (scrollable but touch blocked)

play_button_accessible.details: Play button at offsetTop=5367px is NOT accessible on mobile. User cannot scroll to it via touch. scrollIntoView() works programmatically but not via user touch.

minimum_narration_duration_increased.details: MINIMUM_NARRATION_MINUTES = 10 (increased from 7). Timer shows '10:00' and '10 MIN' label.

somatic_duration_labels_resolve.details: Duration labels resolve correctly. Example: 'Body Tapping' shows '8 minutes' in dialog, timer shows '10:00' (minimum floor applied).

root_cause_analysis.issue: Touch scrolling not working on guided practice overlay
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: body.style.touchAction = 'none' (line 50) blocks all touch events including scroll gestures on child elements. The inner scroll container has touch-pan-y class but it's overridden by the body's touch-action:none.
reproduction_steps: 1. Navigate to /somatic on mobile viewport (390x844 or 375x812)
4. Try to scroll down to see play button - FAILS
5. Play button is at y=5367px but viewport is only 844px
root_cause_analysis.suggested_fix: Option 1: Remove body touch-action:none and rely on overflow:hidden for scroll lock. Option 2: Make outer overlay the sole scroll container by removing overflow-y-auto from inner container. Option 3: Use touch-action:pan-y on overlay with !important to override body.
